summary: A candidate is confined to the files its plan names, and the confinement is re-bound to the exact candidate that reaches judgement: after validation's formatters may have rewritten the worktree and the diff has been re-read, every changed path -- added, modified, deleted or renamed -- must still be one the plan named.
plan: In runCandidate (internal/workflow/engine.go), confine the candidate to the plan's named files TWICE, because validation may rewrite what the reviewer sees: once immediately after the read-only (ModeInspect) refusal and before the candidate.changed event, over the worker's diff; and again immediately after e.validate returns, over the diff e.validate re-read, before the prospective and test-edit inspections, the audit, the Level-1 classification, the review and admission. Both calls use one function placed beside inspectTestEdits and diffFileStates in internal/workflow/testedit.go, taking the diff and the plan's named files only -- it must not take or read test-edit grants, so a grant cannot enlarge the set. The paths come from report.FromDiff(diff).Files (every status, deletions and renames included) and the named set is tc.Files canonicalised with path.Clean(strings.TrimSpace(f)) exactly as architecturalFiles does; the refusal error names every path outside the plan and the plan's named files, and returns from runCandidate the way the ModeInspect refusal does, leaving the candidate worktree as it is. Tests in internal/workflow/engine_test.go: TestCandidateWiderThanPlanIsRefusedBeforeReview (a diff touching one path outside the plan is refused, naming that path; a diff touching only named paths passes; a deletion outside the plan is refused), TestAFormatterCannotWidenTheCandidateAfterValidation (a candidate that is inside its plan when written and outside it after validation rewrote the worktree is refused before audit or review sees it), TestOperationalTestGrantDoesNotExpandPlanScope (the check has no grant input, and a test file that would be grantable but is not named is refused), TestASuppliedPlanIsNotWidenedByTheCandidate (a candidate wider than a supplied plan is refused and the supplied plan's Digest and Files are unchanged). Test in internal/workflow/routine_test.go: TestGovernancePathClassificationCannotMaskScopeWidening (a diff touching internal/workflow/routine.go plus one unnamed path is refused by this check, which does not depend on any Level-1 classification). No other behaviour changes; no signature changes; no new files.
steps: Add the confinement check function in internal/workflow/testedit.go: input the diff and the plan's named files; output an error naming every path outside the plan, or nil.

Call it in runCandidate in internal/workflow/engine.go right after the ModeInspect refusal, and again right after e.validate returns, before the prospective and test-edit inspections; return the error the way the ModeInspect refusal does.
Add the four tests to internal/workflow/engine_test.go and the classification test to internal/workflow/routine_test.go, building unified-diff strings in the tests.
Run gofmt -l cmd internal, go vet ./..., and go test ./... .
consequences: A worker that touches a path the plan did not name no longer reaches validation, audit, review or admission, and a formatter that widens the candidate during validation no longer reaches them either; the plan must be revised and the run repeated. Candidates within their plan behave exactly as before.

claims.statement: runCandidate refuses a read-only plan whose candidate changed files immediately before emitting candidate.changed and calling e.validate; no candidate-vs-plan comparison exists on that path.
e.validate runs formatters that may rewrite the candidate and deliberately re-reads the diff afterwards, so evidence gathered before it describes different bytes.
inspectTestEdits inspects only granted files and diffFileStates already classifies every changed path by status; neither compares the candidate to the plan.
